name: arxiv_rlad_math_reasoning_benchmark_api_sols_merged
description: A merged collection of mathematical problems and associated API-generated solutions intended to evaluate LLMs' mathematical problem-solving and reasoning ability. The benchmark measures whether models produce correct, step-by-step solutions that match reference answers and demonstrates strengths/weaknesses in chain-of-thought reasoning and solution verification. It is used to assess exactness and robustness of generated numerical and symbolic solutions.
reputation: A niche research dataset on HuggingFace used by researchers working on math-reasoning evaluation; limited but growing adoption.
